description:
Returns the current state of an envelope: whether it was delivered, opened, signed, or cancelled, and when each signer signed. Use this to answer "has it been signed yet?".

Read the STATE for whether it is signed, not the signer timestamp. On a completed envelope every signer has signed; a missing signature time only means the time was not recorded.

envelope_id.description: The id returned when it was sent, e.g. env_7mmyc...

name: check_envelope
title: Check an envelope
